subject: School Committee Candidate Interview With John Intoppa
overview: Current School Committee member and candidate John Intoppa discussed his first term on the committee, his work on water safety policy, and his priorities for student voter engagement and arts programming.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Local Favorites
items.summary: John Intoppa introduced his background in student engagement and industrial design, and he shared his favorite local businesses including Goldilocks and Mrs. Murphy's Pub.

items.title: Reflection on Joining the Committee
items.summary: Intoppa described his transition onto the committee to fill a vacancy and his experience navigating a difficult budget cycle that resulted in personnel layoffs.

items.title: Water Wellness Policy and Legislative Work
items.summary: The candidate highlighted his role in authoring a comprehensive lead testing policy for school water supplies and cleaning up the district's policy bank.

items.title: Student Voter Engagement and Education
items.summary: Intoppa proposed a new system for in-house voter education to help students understand registration and voting procedures before they graduate.

items.title: Student Input and Financial Literacy
items.summary: Discussion focused on the role of student liaisons and the importance of expanding 'game of life' career fairs to teach practical financial skills.

items.title: Future Priorities and School Nursing
items.summary: Intoppa outlined goals for his next term, including a new high school building, expanded arts collaborations, and addressing outdated school nurse staffing ratios.

items.title: Campaign Information and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Intoppa provided contact information for his campaign and noted the importance of local media in providing platforms for candidate discussion.
